items.title: Sort the task list by newest first or by due date
done_when: The task list offers a toggle between newest first and due date
Due-date order puts the earliest due date first and tasks without a due date last
Unit tests cover both orders, typecheck, lint and unit tests pass, committed
items.question: Tasks have no due date yet. Should I add one so the list can sort by it?
items.decision_label: Add an optional due date, then the sort toggle
items.owner_note: Optional date only, no time. Keep the sort toggle simple.
